jobs.feedName: David Nazarian College of Business & Economics
jobs.title: Brand Content Intern at Solvely.ai
jobs.description: Employer: Solvely.ai Expires: 07/29/2026 Type: Internship · Part-Time · RemoteLocation: United StatesDescriptionKickstart your content marketing career with Solvely!Solvely is an AI-powered academic tool that helps college students solve complex problems across STEM, business, and more. The students we build for are also the people who know our product best, which is why we hire student creators to make content that actually speaks to other students.We're looking for Brand Content Interns to join our marketing team and create short-form video content (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) about how students study, learn, and use AI tools in their academic lives. You'll be part of a structured 10–12 week internship: we provide weekly scripts and content themes, plus mentorship from our marketing team.You’ll be a fit if you’re:Comfortable being on camera and speaking naturallyConsistent and reliable, able to commit to a weekly content scheduleInterested in social media marketing, content creation, or short-form videoFamiliar with TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube ShortsWhy Solvely:Hands-on mentorship in short-form content marketing.A real, build-able portfolio.** Every video, account, and performance dashboard you produce is yours to keep. By the end of the internship, you'll have a body of work that proves you can ship content at scale.Interns who consistently exceed performance benchmarks are eligible for a recommendation letter from Solvely.Use our AI study tool for your own coursework for free throughout the internship.RequirementsCurrently enrolled US-based college studentStrong English communication skillsInterest in AI-assisted learning and how students use AI tools in their academic lifeBasic short-form video editing skills (CapCut, InShot, Premiere, or similar)ResponsibilitiesManage your dedicated brand account on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and/or YouTube ShortsTrack basic content performance and share weekly observations with our marketing teamProduce 5 short-form videos per week following our weekly scripts and filming templatesMaintain a consistent posting cadence and iterate based on what's workingApplySubmit your application: In addition to the required written information, please share a previous explainer-style short video you've made — could be from school projects, club content, or personal social media. If you don't have one on hand, you could also try filming a quick 20–30 second talking-head clip sharing something about your student life (study tips, campus moments, a course experience, etc.).Application screening — we review your resume, sample video and short answers, and respond within 3 business days.Onboarding — selected interns receive a contract, onboarding guide, and the first week's content templates. We onboard on a rolling basis throughout Fall 2026.

jobs.title: Bilingual Production & Brand Intern (Global Operations) at Magic Wave
jobs.description: Employer: Magic Wave Expires: 07/29/2026 We aren't looking for a "coffee-runner." We are looking for a high-potential Bilingual Intern to act as a force multiplier for our leadership team. You will directly support our Production Operations Lead and Brand Strategy Lead in executing international audio projects.If you live at the intersection of Fan Economy, Celebrity Culture, and Business Operations, this is your playground. You will get hands-on experience in how a global startup turns narrative content into a cult-following brand.Key ResponsibilitiesOperational Support: Assist the Production Operations Lead with project tracking, script critique (English), and coordinating with our global network of voice talent.Brand & Research: Support the Brand Strategy Lead in conducting deep-dive research on fan behavior, celebrity trends, and emerging social media platforms.Bilingual Bridge: Facilitate seamless communication between our US and Asia teams, ensuring that creative nuances are preserved across languages.Content Assistance: Help create engaging social media assets and assist in the basic editing of audio/video content for our marketing channels.Pipeline Health: Maintain high-quality documentation and asset management within our production pipeline.Might need support for YouTube channel operationWhat We’re Looking ForAcademic Background: Current student or recent grad majoring in Media, Film, Communication, or Business.Bilingual Mastery: Professional-level fluency in English and Chinese is non-negotiable. You must be able to translate not just words, but cultural contexts.Pop Culture Junkie: A genuine obsession with Fan Economy and Celebrity Trends. You should understand why certain stars "break the internet" and how fans mobilize.Technical Literacy: Familiarity with Lark/Office suit, CapCut, or Canva.The "Startup Soul": You are proactive, "fierce" in execution, and don't wait to be told what to do next. You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments.Why This Internship MattersReal Leverage: You aren't just observing; you are providing the tactical support that allows our senior leads to scale.Global Ecosystem: Exposure to a unique production model that bridges Hollywood aesthetics with Asian market speed.Mentorship: Direct access to a team of award-winning producers and strategic partners.The Full-Time Track: We hire for keeps. Exceptional interns are prioritized for the “Lead-Track” career path within the company.How to ApplySend your Resume and a Brief Cover Letter (tell us why you are a good fit and/or showcase the project/film that best reflects your creative talent) to: hr@metaelementsinc.com

jobs.title: Fall 2026 WMG Emerging Talent Associate Program (Global Sync) at Warner Music Group
jobs.description: Employer: Warner Music Group Expires: 07/30/2026 At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises. WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences. Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent. We currently have a fantastic opportunity for talented individuals to join our innovative and highly sought-after Emerging Talent Associate Program as an Emerging Talent Associate (ETA) this Fall. Warner Music Group’s Emerging Talent Associate Program is a paid internship program designed to provide individuals with the opportunity to apply their skills and gain hands-on experience in the music industry. This multidimensional, semester-long program begins by matching ETAs to specific departments based on their interests as well as the position qualifications. Here you’ll get to: Upon joining the program, Emerging Talent Associates (ETAs) are fully immersed in the day-to-day activities of their assigned department. They participate in strategic meetings, help solve key business issues, and offer ideas and perspectives to further WMG’s global success. In addition, working as an Emerging Talent Associate ensures access to incredible developmental activities such as our Professional Development Workshops, Industry Insights, and the Emerging Talent Associate Capstone Project. A little bit about the program:Application Deadline: Friday, August 7, 2026 at 11:59pm Program Duration:OPTION ONE: August 31, 2026 - November 6, 2026OPTION TWO: September 8, 2026 - November 13, 2026OPTION THREE: September 14, 2026 - November 20, 2026Scheduled Weekly Hours: 20-25 hours per week (varies based on department)Internship Credit is also provided for students seeking academic credit for this experience A little bit about you:At least 18 years of age by August 31, 2026Located within the United States for the duration of the programHave access to housing and transportation within the designated cityA self-starter attitude with a genuine curiosity for our businessAble to commit to a 20-25 hour work week It would be music to our ears if you also had:Professional goals that align with Warner Music Group’s core values and business objectivesKnowledge of and passion for the different business units that makeup WMGExcellent verbal and written communication skills as well as effective problem solving and organizational skillsStrong passion for and knowledge of the music industryLeadership experience on or off campus Placement Opportunities: Please note the departments listed below are subject to change. Placements tagged as hybrid will require you to work onsite for the majority of the work week. **Business & Legal Affairs is reserved for individuals actively pursuing a law degree.***Creative placements require submission of a creative portfolio for consideration.Clearance (Hybrid Los Angeles, CA)Creative Sync (Hybrid Los Angeles, CA)As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands. Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

jobs.feedName: David Nazarian College of Business & Economics
jobs.title: Marketing Intern at Loansteady
jobs.description: Employer: Loansteady Expires: 07/30/2026 Marketing InternPart-Time | McLean, VA (Hybrid) | Paid About LoansteadyWe’re a small-by-design mortgage company bringing a much-needed dose of humanity to the lending process.We answer the phone, explain every fee, and treat borrowers like people — not leads. Our team works out of McLean, VA, serving clients with the kind of personal touch that big lenders can’t offer and don’t try to.Personal touch, better pricing, good people. That’s it. That’s the whole thing. The roleMost mortgage marketing is pretty boring — generic, forgettable, and it all looks the same. We think that's actually a huge opportunity. There's so much room to do something different in this space, and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that.Our brand voice and content strategy are already built out — we just need someone to help bring it to life day to day. You’ll work closely with leadership across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, email, and more. We’ll get you up to speed and give you more ownership as you grow into it.You’ll start in-office about 3 days a week while you’re learning the ropes, then shift to a more flexible schedule once you’re up and running. What you’ll actually doContent creation — this is the core of the job•Shoot photos and short video at closing days, team moments, and behind-the-scenes office life — real moments, not staged ones. This is the biggest part of the job.•Write and schedule social posts for LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok (we’ll teach you the brand voice)•Help produce carousels and graphics using our templates and AI design tools — you don’t need to be a designer•Draft email and SMS templates in our CRM that sound human, not corporateBrand & community•Keep our social presence active — post on schedule, respond to comments, engage with partners•Monitor and respond to Google reviews (reputation matters when you’re small)•Help maintain consistency across everything we put out — right tone, right look, right languageStrategy support•Track what’s working and what isn’t — engagement, reach, DMs, leads•Help brainstorm campaign ideas and content angles•Support marketing initiatives across email, events, and partner outreachWho you areWe care more about what you can make than what’s on your transcript. Must-haves•You’re a solid writer. Clear, conversational, no fluff. You don’t need to be perfect — just someone who cares about how things sound.•You can shoot good photos and video with your phone. Natural light, candid moments, real people. Show us what you’ve captured.•You’re organized enough to manage a content calendar and keep things moving on schedule.•You’re currently pursuing (or recently completed) a degree in marketing, communications, business, or something adjacent.•You can work from our McLean office ~3 days/week to start. Nice-to-haves•Experience running a real social account (brand, club, side project — not just your personal page)•Basic comfort with email marketing tools (Mailchimp, HubSpot, or similar)•Interest in real estate, finance, or small business — but not required. We’ll teach you the industry.•Comfort with design tools like Canva or Figma (helpful but not required — we have AI tools that handle most graphic work)Why this is worth your time•You’ll work directly with leadership — not buried in a department. Your ideas get heard.•Structured mentorship for your first 1-2 months. Someone will actually teach you, not just hand you a login and say 'figure it out.'•Your work goes live. No mock projects, no hypotheticals. You’ll build a portfolio of real campaigns for a real company.•Flexible schedule that works around school. We care about output, not hours in a chair.•A small team that’s growing — strong performers have a path to a bigger role.How to applySend your resume, a short note about why this sounds interesting, and examples of work you’ve created (photos you've taken, social posts, video clips, writing samples — anything that shows what you can do) to careers@loansteady.com.Subject line: Marketing Intern — [Your Name]No cover letter template needed. Just be yourself.Loansteady is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Economics Intern at The Balmoral Group
jobs.description: Employer: The Balmoral Group Expires: 07/30/2026 Internship PositionThe Balmoral Group - Tallahassee Branch is seeking motivated students with an interest in economics, policy,data science, marketing analytics, and grants management, for a Fall Economist Intern position to support our Economics Team in our Tallahassee, Florida office.Economist interns will gain real world experience as they develop professional working knowledge of industry methods, procedures, and standards while working for our professional Economics Team.Economist interns are responsible for performing a variety of entry level economist tasks including data collection, data analysis, tabulation of charts, graphs and exhibits to support economic analysis, literature review, and policy research related to various projects, as well as market analysis and business development support. Examples include work for the Florida Wildlife Corridor, a Benefit Cost analysis for Monroe County Natural resources, a statewide review of resource allocation at Special Districts (mosquito control districts), statewide DEP Resiliency mapping of critical assets, economic analysis for a Habitat Conservation Plan in Amelia Island, transportation statistics/construction cost modeling for several clients and econometric modeling of housing premiums. Additionally, interns will perform market research activities for the Balmoral Group Tallahassee Office.The Balmoral Group - Tallahassee Branch is seeking motivated students with an interest in economics, policy, data science, marketing analytics, and grants management, for a Economist Intern position to support our Economics Team in our Tallahassee, Florida office.Economist interns will gain real world experience as they develop professional working knowledge of industry methods, procedures, and standards while working for our professional Economics Team.Economist interns are responsible for performing a variety of entry level economist tasks including data collection, data analysis, tabulation of charts, graphs and exhibits to support economic analysis, literature review, and policy research related to various projects, as well as market analysis and business development support. Examples include work for the Florida Wildlife Corridor, a Benefit Cost analysis for Monroe County Natural resources, a statewide review of resource allocation at Special Districts (mosquito control districts), statewide DEP Resiliency mapping of critical assets, economic analysis for a Habitat Conservation Plan in Amelia Island, transportation statistics/construction cost modeling for several clients and econometric modeling of housing premiums. Additionally, interns will perform market research activities for the Balmoral Group Tallahassee Office. Benefits of working with TBG include: Paid ExperienceTechnical TrainingExpert MentorshipAccommodates School Schedule What to Expect... Interns will gain real world experience as they develop professional working knowledge of industry methods,procedures, and standards, while working with our professional economics team. We offer a flexible part-time work schedule (minimum 20 hours, but flexible) that accommodates your school schedule.The Balmoral Group provides economics, data analytics, and strategic advisory services to public and private clients, in natural resources, water and/or transport disciplines. Our clients rely on us for timely, practical advice and innovative solutions. The majority of our work is in the U.S., but we also support our international offices on a range of projects. See website for more information. Work Environment The Balmoral Group is headquartered in downtown Winter Park, Florida with additional offices in Tallahassee, Seattle, and Sydney & Queensland, Australia. The Balmoral Group combines engineering design expertise with economics, environmental analysis and GIS capabilities. Our engineering staff has an excellent reputation for providing high-quality consulting services in the design of urban and rural arterials and freeways/expressways. The Balmoral Group has a personable work environment that provides interns with multi-level mentorship to ensure cross-training and allow for robust professional development in a diversity of projects and tasks.

These events are designed to build awareness, drive ticket sales, create content, strengthen the brand, and introduce more people to cleaner, recovery-focused sleep. Internship OverviewThe Ultimate Snooze is seeking a Brand & Marketing Intern to support the planning, promotion, and execution of a major November brand activation event in Miami, Florida.This is a real-world marketing role — not busy work. The intern will help support the strategy behind how the event is planned, promoted, experienced, and represented to the public. This includes helping with event logistics, influencer outreach, ticket sales marketing, content planning, brand presentation, guest experience, and post-event follow-up.You will gain hands-on experience working with company leadership, the Creative Director, wellness speakers, influencers, brand partners, and retail contacts while helping bring a national wellness event to life. Location — Two Tracks AvailableTrack 1 — Miami, FLRemote interns based in the Miami area will work primarily from home but are expected to attend and help support the October brand activation event in person in Miami.Track 2 — Pueblo / Colorado Springs, COInterns based in Pueblo or Colorado Springs will support event planning, marketing, logistics, and outreach with opportunities for in-person collaboration at The Ultimate Snooze’s Pueblo headquarters. Travel to the Miami event is not required. What You’ll Work OnSupport the marketing strategy and execution for a live brand activation event, including how the event is promoted before, during, and after the experience.Assist with event logistics, including venue research, vendor coordination, guest flow, planning documents, timelines, and event organization.Help support ticket sales marketing through outreach lists, promotional ideas, email/social copy, partner promotion, and campaign tracking.Assist with influencer research and outreach, including identifying wellness, lifestyle, sleep, fitness, and health creators who may help promote or attend the event.Help organize influencer, partner, speaker, and guest communication so outreach stays clear, professional, and on schedule.Support the development of event marketing materials, including messaging, talking points, press release support, promotional copy, brand positioning, and event descriptions.Help build invitation and outreach lists for influencers, retail partners, wellness leaders, media contacts, community partners, and potential event attendees.Support brand representation at the event, including how The Ultimate Snooze is presented visually, verbally, and experientially to guests.Assist with planning the event guest experience, including check-in, product display, brand touchpoints, speaker moments, VIP experiences, and customer engagement.Support content capture planning for photo, video, social media, influencer content, recap content, and post-event marketing assets.Assist with PR and media outreach by helping organize media lists, press materials, follow-up notes, and event coverage tracking.Help with post-event follow-up, including retailer leads, influencer recaps, guest notes, media coverage, content organization, and partner communication. What You’ll LearnHow a national wellness brand uses live events to build awareness, generate content, drive ticket sales, and create business opportunities.How brand activations are planned from concept to execution, including logistics, promotion, guest experience, and post-event marketing.How to support influencer marketing, including creator research, outreach, communication, and campaign organization.How to market an event for ticket sales through social media, email, partner promotion, outreach, and brand storytelling.How to think about brand representation at an event, including visuals, messaging, product presentation, tone, and customer experience.How to communicate professionally with influencers, wellness speakers, executives, media contacts, retail partners, and vendors.Event marketing fundamentals, including run-of-show planning, guest experience design, content planning, and brand storytelling.Public relations basics, including media list building, press release support, journalist outreach, and coverage tracking.How brand activations can create measurable business outcomes, including new retailer relationships, press coverage, social content, influencer partnerships, and customer interest.How to work cross-functionally with marketing, creative, sales, operations, and company leadership on a real brand initiative. Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is organized, curious, creative, and ready to gain real-world experience in brand marketing, event marketing, influencer outreach, and wellness brand development.No prior professional experience is required. A strong interest in marketing, events, public relations, communications, business, wellness, social media, influencer marketing, or brand strategy is encouraged.This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys research, communication, writing, organizing details, helping promote ideas, and seeing how a live event becomes a real marketing opportunity for a growing national brand. Preferred QualificationsCoursework, background, or strong interest in marketing, communications, public relations, business, wellness, events, or brand development.Interest in learning how to support influencer outreach, event promotion, ticket sales marketing, and brand partnerships.Interest in helping with event logistics, including venue research, vendor coordination, planning documents, and guest experience.Interest in social media, content planning, photography, video, influencer marketing, or post-event recap content.Comfortable with research, writing, email communication, spreadsheets, organization, and follow-through.Ability and willingness to attend the October brand activation event in Miami in person, if selected for the Miami track. Contributing to the internal staff newsletter.Assisting with software procurement for a new agency contacts database. THE CANDIDATE:Competitive candidates will have:Experience or strong understanding of state and local government and the legislative process.Strong written and oral communication skills.Familiarity with AP Style and great editing skills.Experience with email marketing platforms, such as Mailchimp or Constant Contact.Experience with Microsoft Office products and Adobe Acrobat. jobs.description: Employer: Democratic National Committee Expires: 08/02/2026 The DNC Technology department is accepting applications for our Fall 2026 Internship Program! This is a separate application from the DNC General Internship Application because it requires specific experience. Interning with DNC Tech is a unique opportunity for future leaders to gain real life, hands-on experience in Democratic political technology, learn and experience industry data & analytics processes, strengthen their understanding of the political process, and prepare them for future political opportunities. The program will run from September 8, 2026 - November 13, 2026 and will be conducted in an in-person, hybrid, or remote format. Interns who are based in the Washington D.C. area will have an opportunity to perform in-person work for the DNC at the Democratic National Headquarters and DNC events. You must be located in the United States to apply for this internship. The DNC Internship Program provides a stipend of $3,000. Housing is not provided. During the upcoming term, interns are expected to work 20 hours per week. The deadline for applications is July 31, 2026. Position Summary:As an intern with DNC Tech, you will work on a project or projects designed to support the work of the overall Tech team and your own skills and experience. You will build your skills as a technology professional, in data analytics, engineering, or data science; software engineering; product; or supporting users of data and technology products, information technology, or security. You will participate in team meetings and work closely with mentor(s). In addition to working on project/s, you may work on a variety of additional tasks relevant to the team you’re interning with. As an intern with DNC Tech, you’ll learn a lot about the interesting ways in which technology intersects politics. As part of the internship program, you will also be expected to assist the DNC Operations team by attending weekly phone shifts and any mandatory onboarding/offboarding sessions. In addition, through the internship program, you will have opportunities to participate in grassroots organizing, assist at DNC functions, receive personal development training, and network with DNC leadership and staff. NOTE: The Data team at the DNC are fully remote teams. Tech interns may work from any contiguous US time zone. If working from AK or HI, you must be able to do work during either Pacific, Mountain, Central, or Eastern time working hours. You will arrange a schedule with a supervisor. Technology interns still have the opportunity to choose among in-person, hybrid, or remote work like every DNC intern, but be aware that your supervisor and mentors will likely be remote. An internship at DNC Tech may be a great fit for you if:You’re willing to learn new things, and you feel comfortable learning and problem-solving on your own, with guidance from a mentor. You enjoy problem-solving and have strong communication skills.You are excited to learn about the ways that tech can support Democratic politics, and to work on things that help others.You have previous experience in politics, e.g. using Votebuilder, or volunteering for a Democratic campaign. (This is NOT required.) For the data internship, we recommend:You have completed at least a semester, ideally two semesters, of computer programming-related courses, OR have equivalent experience. We expect interns on the Data team to have done some computer programming or data manipulation / analysis previouslyOur team uses a lot of SQL, Python, and R but it is okay if you’ve never used one of those before, as long as you have some familiarity with programming or spreadsheet software including Excel or Google Sheets. If you’ve used one of those languages or software, or something else similar to one of those, we encourage you to apply! For the cybersecurity internship, we recommend:You have at least an entry-level skill-set in using MacBooks and Google Suite applicationsOur team constantly has to adapt to industry changes that happen almost daily – therefore, having a passion for technology and learning new things is requiredJamf administration experience: Policy Configuration, PatchingNetwork administration experience: Networking fundamentals. Firewalls and switch administration For the information technology internship, we recommend:You have completed at least a semester of computer information systems or equivalent courses in any of the following areas: computer engineering, networking, AI and machine learning, and operating systemsYou have a general understanding of Google Suite / Workspace and Apple productsAbility to be hands-on and lift up to 25lbs; we often complete office moves or set up equipment for events. Include in your application for a DNC Tech internship:In your cover letter, tell us why do you want to intern here, specifically? Tell us about a time you solved a problem or learned something new. (Briefly - 1 paragraph or less is fine!)Share in your resume and/or cover letter what software / technology / programming skills, and experiences you have. What are the titles of a couple relevant classes you’ve taken? What technology related project /s (ex. an assignment from a class) have you worked on? This information helps us determine whether we have a project that will match your experience and interest. About the team:The DNC Technology department (aka DNC Tech) is a small, collaborative, multi-disciplinary tech team – we provide the tech foundation for Democratic politics. You can learn more about the team here. We build tools and applications that help elect Democrats year over year. Our work is an incredibly important background part of running successful Democratic campaigns around the country, including:Ensuring permissions and onboarding/offboarding work properly and that our data tools are secure,Ensuring we have accurate, accessible data,Building tools so that people working hard on campaigns and in other political roles can save time and energy,Making it possible for those with voter protection expertise to share accurate information about how to vote,Supporting people throughout the Democratic ecosystem with secure hardware, software, device management, and other technology problems,… and much more. It is highly recommended that applicants complete at least one full term prior to submitting an application.Graduated from an undergraduate or graduate program at a college, community college, or university (two-to-four year institution) no more than two years before the first day of the internship.A veteran of the United States Armed Forces who possesses a high school diploma or its equivalent and has served on active duty, for any length of time, in the two years preceding the first day of the internship. Applicants must meet all of the following criteria:Commitment of 20 hours per week during the programPhysically present in the United States to participate in this internship program Required Application Materials:ResumeCover letterReferences

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Internship (Remote) at Brilliant PR and Marketing
jobs.description: Employer: Brilliant PR and Marketing Expires: 08/06/2026 Brilliant Agency, one of the most respected and rapidly growing agencies focused on family-oriented brands, seeks a REMOTE Influencer Marketing Intern, 15 hours a week to help support the agency’s growing, award-winning team for Winter/Spring 2027.Who We Are:So what’s Brilliant all about? We are a unique PR agency with nearly 25 team members who all work remotely across the US. We give our team the resources they need to get their work done without having to sit in a cubicle or stuffy office. From costume contests to virtual happy hours and Slack GIFs, we prioritize connecting with each other and creating a sense of community. Although we are remote, team members are expected to be available online during regular business hours, and there is occasional travel for events and trade shows.What We Do:Brilliant is in its second decade as a fully remote company and is one of the most respected agencies serving consumer lifestyle brands with a specific focus on products, brands, and services including beauty, wellness, baby, maternity, toys and games, tech, housewares, food, and more! What We’re Looking For:Our Dream Team Member:Excited about the prospect of not knowing what tomorrow will bring. Enjoys crossing things off your to-do listResourceful, committed, and deliberateReads media, scrolls TikTok, and finds new brands and start-upsShares in brainstorms and isn’t afraid to come up with and try new ideas while encouraging others to speak upWants to be a part of a small but strong and mighty teamAppreciates the art of public relations and all of the (sometimes crazy!) moving partsPassionate about influencer marketing. Being a parent is not a requirement, but being a kid at heart is! Job Description:We have two internship sessions – Summer/Fall (June-December) and Winter/Spring (January-June/July) – and many interns end up staying for multiple sessions. Active interns get first pick for the following semester internship spots! This isn’t an internship to organize files, it’s the one where you are truly integrated into a team to understand how it operates and the fundamentals of a strong career in influencer marketing. With that, it is critical that interns can meet deadlines, respond to messages in a timely manner, and be proactive in communicating with their team.Potential Responsibilities Include:Use technology platforms such as CreatorIQ, Google Drive, AirTable, Cision, Google, TikTok, Instagram, and more to assist your team in, research, media and influencer relations, social media, content creation, and moreLearn how to identify influencer targets and assist your team in building listsHelp your team monitor influencer, and social coverage on behalf of clients Learn how to use influencer marketing sourcing tools to find influencers for client activationsBuild relationships with influencers and agents to further the success of clientsLearn how to write an engaging caption across Instagram, TikTok, and FacebookImprove your writing skills but drafting press materials and research materialMaintenance and updating of critical databases/resourcesData entry and miscellaneous research to help with projects such as award submissions, event recommendations, planning events, and moreRequirements Include:You must be a rising sophomore, junior or seniorPrevious office internship experience required in the marketing space3.0 GPA or aboveCommit at least 15 hours a week during our normal office hours or 8-5 in your time zoneExcellent writing skillsSocial media savvyStrong organizational abilitiesProfessional demeanor and a drive to succeedEagerness to learn and willingness to ask questionsResourceful attitude and keen attention to detail***Prior to applying for this position, please contact your College or University Career Center and verify that you are eligible to receive College Credits for an Internship although accepting credit hours is not necessary to accept an offer. jobs.title: Research Intern at International Institute for Strategic Studies (IISS)
jobs.description: Employer: International Institute for Strategic Studies (IISS) Expires: 08/06/2026 IISS–Americas Research Internship on Technology, Trade and GeopoliticsLocation: Washington DCThe International Institute for Strategic Studies (IISS) is a defence and security think tank that has a deep understanding of regional geopolitics and geo-economics in a global context. Its international researchers provide best-in-class, independent and impartial analysis and offer insights on strategic challenges and priorities to governments and the private sector. It is expert at bringing together national leaders and senior policymakers in foreign policy, defence and security; promoting dialogue; and facilitating effective and influential bilateral and multilateral consultations. The International Institute for Strategic Studies – Americas is seeking one student intern to work up to 20 hours per week to support a research program on technology, trade and geopolitics. The start and end dates are flexible with a preference for those available from late August to mid-December.The successful applicant will gain direct exposure to the research, publications and management of a leading international think tank. We are looking for an intern with a strong academic background focused on international relations or national-security studies, ideally with an interest in emerging technologies and international trade.Responsibilities: Conducting research and writing on technical issues, policy developments and diplomacy regarding technology and trade;Performing operational tasks to assist in convening virtual and in-person events;Performing outreach to both government and non-government entities;Supporting IISS–Americas researchers with ad-hoc research, data-collection, writing, editing and fundraising projects;Conducting stakeholder mapping, preparing background materials and drafting talking points for IISS advisory briefings.Requirements:Successful candidates will:Have good substantive knowledge of current trends in international security, particularly emerging technologies relevant to national security and/or international trade;Be able to write quickly and clearly;Be a proactive self-starter and able to work in a small team environment;Be proficient in Microsoft Excel;Be eligible to work in the United States. The IISS–Americas regrets that it cannot assist with procuring visas or entry permits. Please indicate your work eligibility in your application.Candidates pursuing a master’s degree are preferred, but we will consider exceptional undergraduates.Eligibility and Compensation:This is an in-person internship paid at $18/hr for up to 20 hours per week. Applicants must reside in the DC metro area at the time of the internship.Application:Interested candidates can proceed by pressing the blue ‘apply now’ button and follow the steps to submit only two documents:A CVA one-page cover letter combined with a writing sample (up to 2,500 words in length)The writing sample can be a stand-alone work or an excerpt focusing on any topic. When uploading your documents, please merge the cover letter and writing sample to create a single PDF while submitting the resume as a stand-alone PDF.The deadline for the application is Monday, 13th July 2026 at 7:00PM EST.Due to the volume of expected applications, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.The IISS is an equal-opportunities employer.

Support the drafting of press releases, social media posts, op-eds, and other written publications.Attend and/or contribute to the planning and execution of press freedom-related events. Fundraising:As needed, minimal assistance with:Building development pipelines through prospect and donor research.Donor record upkeep.Appeals/acquisitions via email and standard mail.Grant applications.Fundraising event support. LogisticsWe will consider applications for both full-time (40 hours per week) and part-time (minimum of 20 hours per week) interns for the fall term, which will start in September and conclude in December. Thus, the intern must be residing in the Washington, DC area during the internship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for internship opportunities at this time. In addition, the intern is paid a monthly stipend of $600 for part time and $1,000 for full time. Applicant Qualifications:Interested in press freedom, human rights, journalism and/or international nonprofits.Interested in the US policymaking process.Experience communicating with external stakeholders as part of an organization.Excellent communication (written and verbal).Developed research skills, including finding original sources, compiling data in impactful ways, and tailoring outputs for different audiences.Agility in task management, from long-term projects to breaking news responses.An eye for creative solutions to entrenched problems.Familiarity with using various software programs at other organizations.Strong time management.Media literate and an avid news consumer.Able to work in-person in Washington, DC during the summer per our hybrid (in-office/remote) schedule.Detail-oriented.Proactive.Reliable.Native-level English proficiency.French language skills not required, but a plus. jobs.description: Employer: Inner Peak Expires: 08/07/2026 This position is ideal for a recent college graduate looking for their first sales role or a college student looking to earn a little extra money and gain valuable experience. We are a lean team trying to keep costs low. This role is compensated solely based on results - you will be paid per meeting you book for our CEO, as well as a percentage of any deal that closes. There is no base salary, and we have no flexibility on this. If you are not comfortable working on commission only, please do not apply. Summary: Inner Peak AI (www.innerpeak.ai) is blending new AI technology with human therapist expertise to deliver truly personalized, affordable mental wellness support 24/7. We are starting by serving high school and college students but eventually intend to be everyone’s mental wellness safety net, triaging users and delivering them to video content, human therapists, or crisis resources. We are a mission-driven company created out of our founders; own lived experience and struggles with mental health, and are still a small (but motivated) team. Peak’s founders met in undergrad at Harvard a decade ago before reconnecting recently over their shared interest in technology and mental health. We have built and launched a mobile application that has two thousand users and is live at several high schools. Initial student usage data is strong, giving us powerful case studies. To raise our next round of fundraising, we must scale this to more schools. We are looking for hungry interns who care about making a difference in peer mental health and who want high-upside potential through our performance-based compensation. This role is great training for anyone interested in going into sales, as you will report to a sales manager with 10+ years of sales experience. If you are successful at this role, over time it could turn into a full account executive role with a base salary. jobs.description: Employer: Appalachian Conservation Corps Expires: 08/07/2026 Title: Cultural Landscapes Inventory Individual Placement Service Site: Based out of Washington, DC (remote or hybrid eligible) Dates of Service: September 14th, 2026 – January 22nd, 2027 Pay: $800/week paid biweekly ($600/week living stipend + $200 additional member benefit) Status: This is a full-time, temporary AmeriCorps National Service position. Questions? Contact ACCIPrecruiting@conservationlegacy.org Appalachian Conservation Corps: Our Individual Placement program works to connect young people to conservation service work across Appalachia and neighboring communities in Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, DC, Ohio, and Pennsylvania. ACC is a program of Conservation Legacy, a nationwide network of conservation organizations. As an AmeriCorps program, Individual Placements commit to a term of service in order to gain hands-on experience at their placement site, and ACC supports them through their term, as well as provides a variety of benefits to help them succeed in achieving their career goals. ACC welcomes national applicants, but also emphasizes the engagement of local individuals who represent the communities in which they serve. Position Summary: The Cultural Landscapes Inventory (CLI) Individual Placement will support Preservation Services. Preservation Services promotes the preservation of cultural landscapes and historic structures through research, planning, and stewardship to parks and historic properties in the National Park Service (NPS) National Capital Region. The successful candidate will work with and assist historical landscape architects, historians, and other preservation professionals to complete Cultural Landscapes Inventory (CLI) reports for Prince William Forest Park, a 15,000-acre park in the NPS National Capital Region. This internship opportunity is located in Washington, DC, with options for a remote or hybrid work schedule, and will focus on office work with possible field documentation experience. The internship involves preparing Cultural Landscapes Inventory (CLI) reports and database entries for three cabin camps at Prince William Forest Park. The cabin camps were constructed as part of New Deal-era Recreation Demonstration Area program and include development and use from their completion, to World War II, to the National Park Service’s Mission 66 and Parkscape USA programs, and extend to the present day. The development of the reports and data entry into the Cultural Resources Inventory System (CRIS) database is critical to meeting requirements of Section 106 and 110 of the National Historic Preservation Act. This opportunity will allow the intern to learn about and participate in a preservation program by working directly with Federal cultural resource professionals in the National Capital Region – Preservation Services. Essential roles and responsibilities include: Researching secondary sources and developing written narratives; Identifying and describing cultural landscape characteristics and features; Describing a landscape's historical significance according to National Register criteria; Evaluating characteristics and features that contribute to a landscape’s significance Participating in landscape condition discussions with NPS staff; Photography management with Adobe Creative Suite software; Editing maps using GIS and/or Adobe Creative Suite software General Qualifications: To qualify, you must be between the ages of 18 and 30, and a US citizen that has received a high school diploma or GED. All offers of employment are conditional upon completion of an acceptable check of the National Sex Offender Public Registry and federal criminal background check. Must be eligible to receive an AmeriCorps Education Award. In addition, applicants must: Possess a valid driver’s license Desired Skills/Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in historic preservation, landscape architecture, architecture, urban planning, geography, or historic archaeology with a Mid-Atlantic focus Schedule: This position is full-time, 40 hour/week Typically, this position is expected to serve Monday to Friday, but exact service schedules may vary. A half hour lunch break will not be counted towards AmeriCorps service. Benefits: $800/week paid biweekly ($600/week living stipend + $200 additional member benefit) $2,817.14 AmeriCorps Segal Education Award upon successful completion of 675-hour minimum service term (award amount varies based on length of commitment and can be used for paying off federal student loans or paying tuition for a Title IV accredited college) $802 for professional development fund $1000 for travel during service term Eligibility for the Public Land Corps Hiring Authority upon successful completion – noncompetitive hiring status for two years when applying for federal positions. Federal student loan forbearance and interest payoff Member Assistance Program– 3 free sessions of support with a counseling or work-life balance specialist Additional subject-specific certifications and trainings may be offered (Chainsaw training, pesticides, etc.) Depending upon the academic institution and program, positions may fulfill internship requirements Professional development opportunities (mentorship, resume support, alumni listserv, etc.) and exposure to resource management career paths Evaluation and Reporting: As an AmeriCorps member, performance will be evaluated on whether the member has completed the required number of hours, the member has satisfactorily completed assignments, and if the member has met other performance criteria that were clearly communicated at the beginning of the term of service. Reporting requirements include, but are not limited to, bi-weekly timesheets and accomplishment tracking. Our Commitment: Conservation Legacy is committed to the full consideration of all qualified individuals and will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to perform essential job functions. Physical requirements may include periodic overnight travel, non-traditional work hours, ability to move across varied terrain, use program-specific tools and a range of technology on an infrequent or frequent basis. Exerting up to 25 pounds of force occasionally to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. The ability to safely drive an organizational vehicle may also be required for some positions. If you need assistance and/or reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please send a request to the hiring manager. Our Promise: Conservation Legacy is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or reasonable accommodations due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please send a request to the hiring manager.
